successCriteria.description: IBalanceService exposes getBalancesForEmployee(employeeId: string): Promise<BalanceSummary[]> and BalanceService implements it, returning one BalanceSummary per leave type that has an open balance row in its current accrual period.
Each BalanceSummary computes available = entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays and carries leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd, entitledDays, usedDays, pendingDays from the matched balance row.

When no balance row exists for a policy's current period, that leave type is omitted (no synthesized entry, no throw); an employee with no open periods returns [] and one missing period does not fail the whole request.
The current accrual period is computed via the shared periodContaining(employee.hireDate, policy.accrualPeriodMonths, new Date()) from src/shared/date/accrual.ts — no re-derived private copy is used.

The route resolves the actor from request.user (never a client-supplied id), returns 200 with the array, and maps AppError via sendError; the service is resolved from fastify.balanceService or a createBalanceService() factory.
index.ts exports BalanceSummary, getBalancesForEmployee (via IBalanceService), createBalanceService, and balanceRoutes.

constraints: Read-only operation: getBalancesForEmployee must never open a transaction (no uow.withTransaction) and must not forward a PoolClient to repository/service calls.
The balance module must obtain the policy service via createPolicyService() from ../policy — never hand-wire PolicyService/LeaveTypeService/PgLeavePolicyRepository internals.
The accrual period must be computed with the shared periodContaining from src/shared/date/accrual.ts; do not re-derive or duplicate the private addMonths/periodContaining logic.
The actor id must come from request.user via the resolveActor pattern; never accept a client-supplied employee id.
balanceRoutes must not be mounted in src/app.ts in this phase.
outOfScope: Mounting balanceRoutes in src/app.ts (deferred to Phase 7).
Synthesizing a balance entry for a leave type whose current period has no balance row.
Opening/closing balance periods or any write to leave_balances (openPeriod/carryForward are unchanged).
Unit tests and smoke-check extension for this endpoint (deferred to Phase 7).

entityInvariants.invariant: A pure value type derived from a LeaveBalance row; available is always entitledDays - usedDays - pendingDays (never stored, never independently settable), and it is only produced for a leave type whose current-period balance row exists.
Unchanged: at most one row per (employeeId, leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd); OPEN vs CLOSED inferred from period boundaries, not stored. getBalancesForEmployee reads it without mutation.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller is the authenticated actor; the route passes actor.id (never a client-supplied id).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Read-only; returns [] (not 404) when no open periods; omits a leave type with no balance row rather than throwing; propagates NotFoundError only if the employee itself is unknown.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: resolveActor enforces request.user presence and role membership at the API boundary (GP-005); missing/invalid actor -> 401 UnauthorizedError.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: 200 with the array (possibly empty); AppError mapped via sendError to { error, code } with correct status; other throws -> 500.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Compute the current accrual period using the shared periodContaining(anchor, accrualMonths, date) — match its exact signature and half-open { start, end } semantics; do not re-derive it.
Obtain active policies via IPolicyService.getActivePolicies(asOf) (at most one ACTIVE policy per leaveTypeCode, latest effectiveFrom) — reuse the Phase 3 contract, not a re-implementation.
Resolve the employee via IEmployeeService.getEmployeeById(employeeId) and read employee.hireDate as the accrual anchor.
Look up the balance via IBalanceRepository.findByKey(employeeId, leaveTypeCode, periodStart, periodEnd) and reuse its at-most-one-row-per-key semantics.
Reuse the resolveActor and sendError patterns (actor from request.user, AppError -> { error, code } with correct status) exactly as in the leave routes.
Wire the fallback service via createPolicyService() from the policy module's public entry point — never hand-wire policy internals.

integrationPoints.why: Single source of truth for accrual-period computation; the balance read must not re-derive it.
Enumerates the effective policies whose current periods drive the balance list.
Resolves the employee and its hireDate anchor for period computation.
Reads the current-period balance row (or null to omit the type).
Reused actor resolution and error-mapping conventions for the new route.
